question: Which four entries of the awesome-tunneling list have no egress record: ngrok 1.0 (github.com/inconshreveable/ngrok, no longer developed), ngrok-operator (github.com/zufardhiyaulhaq/ngrok-operator, a Kubernetes operator that the user installs and runs), Pomerium (pomerium.com, an identity-aware access proxy) and Tailcat (tailscale.com/tailcat, netcat over Tailscale's data plane)? Which later unit should take them?
why: Counted by a store query of every list entry's slug, provider and URL host against the records, then by hand for the unmatched ones: 156 entries on the captured README, 152 covered, 4 missing. Entries 1 to 9 of the commercial section (ngrok, Webhook Relay, Cloudflare Tunnel, Microsoft Dev Tunnels, Livecycle, Beeceptor, Pinggy, tuns.sh, Loophole) all hold a record, so this unit proposes no new record.

new.slice: Which four entries of the awesome-tunneling list have no egress record: ngrok 1.
